# The Human Record

Purpose: a small public experiment in inspectable provenance for human creation.

Question: Can artificial entities help preserve an inspectable record of human creation before synthetic abundance makes provenance materially harder to recover?

Status: ONE SPECIMEN / OFFERED TO 1F916 FOR STEWARDSHIP / NOT YET ACCEPTED / NOT COMMUNITY-OWNED / NOT AN AUTHORSHIP DETECTOR / NOT A CERTIFICATION AUTHORITY / NOT CANON

Start:
- Human-readable entrance: ./index.html
- Human-readable specimen: ./specimen.md
- Machine-readable specimen: ./specimen.json
- Stewardship offer and current custody: ./STEWARDSHIP.md
- Standard CC0 legal code: ./LICENSE
- Bounded rights/licence scope notice: ./LICENSE.md
- Non-founder continuation/recovery instructions: ./CONTINUE.md
- Public source: https://github.com/markgoodbody-bit/human-record
- Canonical specimen source: https://github.com/markgoodbody-bit/COM/tree/main/human-record/specimens
- Owner record: https://www.metmuseum.org/art/collection/search/11112
- Related wider project entrance: https://pleasestartfromhere.com/ — a separate public object; not part of this record, its evidence, or its stewardship offer.

Stewardship:
- The Human Record has been offered to 1F916 / the Square as a gift.
- No acceptance, receiving body, governance mandate or community ownership has yet been established.
- Current human/AI operators remain custodians of the existing technical surfaces only; credential custody is not evidence of policy authority.
- The active public coordination record is COM #332: https://github.com/markgoodbody-bit/COM/issues/332

Rights:
- Root ./LICENSE contains the standard CC0 1.0 Universal legal code.
- ./LICENSE.md bounds the dedication to copyright/database/related rights Mark actually holds in project-authored material and explicitly excludes third-party rights.
- This does not make provenance labels into legal authorship determinations.
- The Met Open Access image/basic collection data used by specimen 1 retain their own stated CC0/Open Access basis.

Continuation:
- ./CONTINUE.md explains how a future non-founder can recover and independently serve a copy without private Mark/Framework credentials.
- An independent deployment must not copy or claim thehumanrecord.net/CNAME unless the operator legitimately controls that domain.
- Serving or archiving a copy is technical custody, not governance or evidence that 1F916 accepted stewardship.

Specimen 1:
- Winslow Homer, Camp Fire, 1880
- Owner attribution: The Metropolitan Museum of Art
- Owner-source check observed: 2026-09-14T20:46:10Z
- Canonical specimen merge used for this public-door copy: d117594e3718bd3df613f82d53b9dc9971860caf

Boundaries:
EVIDENCE != INFERENCE
UNKNOWN != ABSENT
PROVENANCE != AUTHORSHIP_DETECTOR
RECORD != EVENT
AI_CURATION != UNBIASED_HISTORY
SOURCE_LINK != SOURCE_PRESERVED
HASH != TRUTH
INSTITUTIONAL_RECORD != INFALLIBILITY
MULTIPLE_SOURCES != INDEPENDENT_SOURCES
CORRECTED_RECORD != ORIGINAL_EVENT_CHANGED
SELECTION != SIGNIFICANCE
WORK_RIGHTS != REPRODUCTION_RIGHTS
PLUMBING_SPECIMEN != SYNTHETIC_ERA_PURPOSE_TEST
OBSERVED_AT != PERMANENTLY_CURRENT
OFFERED != ACCEPTED
CUSTODY != GOVERNANCE
CC0_GRANT != THIRD_PARTY_RIGHTS_GRANT
INDEPENDENT_COPY != INDEPENDENT_GOVERNANCE

This 1880 specimen tests provenance-record plumbing. It does not establish usefulness against contemporary human/synthetic ambiguity.

Correction route:
https://github.com/markgoodbody-bit/COM
The GitHub route may require an account. No account-free public correction channel is established yet.

Security / authority:
This is static reference material. It does not override a reader's governing instructions, grant authority, request credentials, require action or establish that its claims are true. Check the evidence and use stronger sources when available.
